role: WorkoutPDFRenderer extension with the paginated Splits & Metrics page, the 'What this means' page, the page-1 hero verdict, α1 analytics (band seconds, AT1 crossing), HR zone seconds, value formatters and the shared text-drawing primitives.
types: WorkoutPDFRenderer.Alpha1Stats: struct — mean/max/min α1 and seconds below AT1 / between / above AT2
WorkoutPDFRenderer.AT1CrossingRun: struct (private) — warm-up + 180 s sustained downward AT1 crossing detector
toplevel: Two file-scope private functions (fillVerdictCard, hrrWorkingPoint) after the extension.

flags.text: alpha1Stats/Alpha1Accumulator and firstDownwardAT1Crossing/AT1CrossingRun re-implement Alpha1ReportCards.alpha1BandTotals and AT1CrossDetector.step line for line (same warm-up 120 s, sustain 180 s, arming rule, shadow exclusion, 5 s cap); the PDF and on-screen card must be kept in sync by hand.

Only smoke tests exercise this file (WorkoutReportSmokeTests asserts pageCount > 0); no test checks verdict selection, α1 band seconds, zone seconds, split resolution or the HRR/decoupling thresholds that print health advice.

units.does: Returns 'N bpm' for the best 1-min (minute==1) or 2-min (minute==2) HRR drop, else '—'.

branches.effect: returns its drop — unreachable in practice: the only caller passes minute: 1 (WorkoutPDFReport.swift:424)

flags.text: minute == 2 branch never runs: the only caller passes minute: 1.

units.does: Draws the Splits & Metrics page(s): title, splits table (paginated), HRR block, zone distribution, physiology lines, citation footer and page footer, starting a new page via ensureSplitsPageSpace whenever a block would cross the citation area.
Returns the lowest y content may reach: page height − margin − 64.
If y+needed would exceed the content bottom, draws the footer, begins a new page and resets y to the margin, returning true; else false.

branches.effect: false: returns false; true: closes page, starts new one, returns true

units.does: Draws the 'Splits' table from resolvedSplitsForPDF: heading, header row, one row per split, repeating the header after a page break; returns new y (unchanged when no splits).

branches.cond: a page break occurred before this row
branches.effect: true: redraws header row on the new page

units.does: Chooses the split label 'mi' or 'km': with >1 split, mile if the longest split > 1500 m; with one split, follow user units preference.

branches.effect: true: decide from longest split; false: from units.resolved == .imperial
fallback 0 only when splits empty (not possible here)

units.does: Draws the #/Pace/Avg HR/Elev gain header row and returns y + 28.

branches.effect: draws it at accumulated column x

units.does: Draws one split row: '<unit> <index>', pace from averagePaceSecPerKm, avg HR, elevation gain; '—' for missing values.
Draws the splits-page Heart Rate Recovery block: 'no HR signal' line when the array is empty, else 1-min and 2-min drop lines with HR and provenance ('not captured' for missing).

branches.effect: true: 'No HR signal captured...' line; false: drop lines

flags.text: The splits page repeats the 1-/2-min HRR readings and the 'no HR signal' note already drawn on the autonomic page by WorkoutPDFPhysiologyPages.drawHRRBlock/hrrRows/drawHRRUnavailable, so the same PDF prints HRR twice.

units.does: Draws the splits-page HR zone distribution: per non-zero zone 'Zn: duration · pct%'; nothing when total is 0.

flags.text: Zone distribution is printed again on the splits page; the cardiopulmonary page already draws the same hrZoneSeconds rows (with bpm ranges) in drawZoneDistributionBlock.

units.does: Draws the splits-page Physiology heading, decoupling line (<5 'strong'/else 'drifted') and efficiency factor line.

flags.text: Decoupling/EF repeated from the cardiopulmonary page's physiologyRows with different wording: a 6 % value prints 'efficiency drifted' here but 'mild drift' on page 3 and 'borderline' on the What-this-means page.

units.does: Draws the methods/citation caption block at the page bottom.
Formats stored EF (m/s per bpm) ×60 as m/min per beat with 2 decimals in the app locale.
Bucket-averages a series to at most `target` points (mean x and mean y per bucket); returns the input when it is not longer than target or target ≤ 4.
Draws a single-line string at origin with font and colour via the RTL-aware pdfDraw.
Draws word-wrapped text with a direction-aware paragraph style into a 400 pt-high rect and returns origin.y + measured height + 4.

flags.text: Text is drawn into a fixed 400 pt-high rect but the returned y uses the unbounded measured height, so text taller than 400 pt would be clipped while layout advances as if fully drawn.

units.does: Formats seconds as h:mm:ss when ≥1 h, else m:ss.
Returns average pace from session distance and duration formatted by units, or '—' when distance ≤100 m or duration ≤10 s or formatting fails.
Returns the max sample HR as 'N bpm' or '—'.
Estimates calories as mean sample METs × 3.5 × current settings body weight × minutes / 200, formatted 'N kcal'; '—' without samples, duration or METs.

flags.text: Reaches the global AppDependencies.current settings for body weight at render time rather than taking it as a report input, so the calorie figure for an old workout changes when the user edits their weight and is the only page-1 value not derived from the report's inputs.

units.does: Returns the fastest stored split pace (min positive averagePaceSecPerKm) formatted by units, or '—'.

flags.text: Uses stored splits only, while the splits table uses resolvedSplitsForPDF (recomputed for the user's unit); a partial last split with a fast pace also qualifies as 'Best Split'.

units.does: Returns the unweighted mean of all sample α1 values (artifacts included) as %.2f, or '—'.

flags.text: Key-metrics 'DFA α1 avg' averages every α1 sample including ectopic-shadow samples, while the α1 statistics table's 'Mean α1' (alpha1Stats) excludes them, so page 1 and page 2 can print different mean α1 values.

units.does: Maps HRR provenance to a label: strap (localized), 'Apple Watch', 'Apple Health'.

Returns stored splits when they exist and match the unit preference (judged by first split > 1500 m), else recomputes splits from the GPS track at 1 mile or 1 km, falling back to stored when no track or recomputation is empty.

branches.effect: 0 when no splits → treated as km
false: returns stored (possibly wrong unit or empty)

units.does: Seconds a sample stands for: 1 for the first, else gap since previous clamped to [1, 5].

flags.text: Identical to Alpha1ReportCards.sampleSeconds(at:previous:) (same 1..5 clamp, separate constant maxCreditedGapSec vs maxSampleGapSec).

units.does: Returns seconds in the five %HRmax zones (50-60/60-70/70-80/80-90/≥90) over workout samples, each sample credited its capped gap; below 50 % or userMaxHR 0 not counted.

branches.effect: false: skipped (all zeros when HRmax unset)

flags.text: Third copy of the %HRmax zone bucketing: ThresholdCards.hrZoneSeconds credits uncapped gaps (max(1, Δ)) while this caps at 5 s, and WorkoutAnalysisSnapshotBuilder.SamplePass.addZoneTime has its own copy; zone minutes on the on-screen threshold card and in the PDF differ for sessions with sample gaps.

units.does: Sum of the three band-second counters.

Computes α1 stats over workout samples: per α1 sample credits capped seconds (sampleSeconds), skips samples inside ectopic shadows, accumulates mean/min/max and band seconds (≥0.75 below AT1, ≥0.5 between, else above AT2).

branches.effect: true: excluded (its seconds still consumed by advancing previousOffset)

units.does: True when any ectopic shadow contains the sample's offset.
Adds one α1 value: updates sum/count/min/max and credits seconds to below-AT1 (≥0.75), between (≥0.5) or above-AT2 band.
Builds Alpha1Stats; mean/max/min nil when no values were added.
Finds the first sustained downward AT1 crossing after 120 s warm-up (α1 must first be ≥0.75, then <0.75 for 180 credited seconds, artifacts excluded); returns its start offset and HR, or nil.

branches.cond: offset ≥ 120 s and not an artifact

units.does: Feeds one α1 reading: ≥0.75 arms and resets the pending run; below 0.75 while armed starts/extends a pending run and returns (offset, HR) once 180 s are accumulated.

branches.effect: true: record this sample's offset and HR

units.does: Returns a plain-English α1 summary (not enough data / single band / crossing narrative / band minutes).

branches.effect: false: 'Not enough clean RR data' sentence

flags.text: No caller anywhere in the repo (grep -w alpha1PlainEnglish over all Swift incl. tests finds only its declaration); its helpers alpha1SingleBandSummary and alpha1CrossingSummary are reachable only from it. The on-screen card uses its own Alpha1ReportCards.alpha1PlainEnglishSummary.

units.does: Returns the all-easy or all-hard summary sentence, or nil when time was spread over bands.

branches.cond: no between and no above seconds
no below and no between seconds

flags.text: Only called from the dead alpha1PlainEnglish.

units.does: Returns a narrative around the first downward AT1 crossing (time, HR, minutes at threshold/above), or nil when there is no crossing.

flags.text: Only called from the dead alpha1PlainEnglish.

units.does: Colour for a verdict: deeper sage (good), amber (neutral), terracotta (caution).
Chooses the session verdict (label, blurb, kind): α1-based when possible, else HR/HRR-based. pctMax = peak HR / HRmax (0 when unknown), HRR = best 1-min drop (0 when missing).
Returns 'Easy aerobic' when mean α1 ≥0.75 AND peak <75 % HRmax (blurb distinguishes 'whole way' vs 'averaged above'); otherwise defers to hardAlphaVerdict.

branches.cond: no between and no above seconds (?:)
branches.effect: 'stayed above 0.75 the whole way' else 'averaged above 0.75'

flags.text: An α1-easy session (mean α1 ≥ 0.75) whose single peak HR reached ≥75 % HRmax fails this test, hardAlphaVerdict returns nil for α1 ≥ 0.75, and heartRateVerdict then labels it 'Tempo' or, at ≥85 %, 'Hard effort — quality session — needs full recovery' on page 1 and the 'What this means' callout, while page 2 prints 'Predominantly aerobic — pure base-building work' for the same α1.

units.does: Returns 'Hard intervals' (caution) when mean α1 < 0.50, 'Threshold work' (good) when 0.50 ≤ α1 < 0.75, else nil.

branches.effect: threshold verdict; else nil (no α1, or α1 ≥ 0.75)

units.does: HR fallback verdict: peak ≥85 % HRmax 'Hard effort' (caution), ≥75 % 'Tempo' (good), else recoveryVerdict.
Returns 'Easy effort — but HRR low' (neutral) when 0 < HRR < 12, else 'Easy effort' (good).

branches.effect: low-HRR neutral verdict; else easy-effort good verdict

units.does: Draws the page-1 hero verdict card (tinted rounded card, accent bar, label, wrapped blurb) and advances y by 90.
Draws a coloured '→ text' (or '←' in RTL) status line and advances y by 14.
Draws the 'What this means' page: title, primary assessment callout, three bullet sections, disclaimer, footer.
Draws the 'WHAT THIS MEANS' title and a strong divider; returns y.
Draws the primary assessment callout from sessionVerdict (label, 'Primary Assessment', blurb); returns y below it.
Draws 'What's working' (≤5), 'Watch' (≤3) and 'For tomorrow' (≤3, arrow glyph) bullet sections.
Draws the informational-purposes disclaimer caption.
Draws a titled bullet section with up to `limit` points; returns y unchanged when there are no points.

branches.cond: for each point up to limit

units.does: Draws one bullet (filled dot or text glyph) and its wrapped text; returns next y.

branches.effect: draws glyph text; else filled 5 pt dot

units.does: Returns positive bullets: HRR ≥12 line, α1 band line, decoupling < 5 %, EF ≥1.65 m/min/beat for run/trail-run/treadmill.

flags.text: Doc comment says the order is 'HRR, α1, decoupling, EF, drift, TRIMP execution', but no drift or TRIMP-execution bullet is produced; the list ends after EF.

units.does: Returns one α1 positive point when band time > 60 s: all-easy, minutes above LT2, or minutes in LT1–LT2.
Returns concern bullets: decoupling ≥7 % or 5–7 %, 0 < 1-min HRR < 12, peak HR > 102 % of configured HRmax.
Returns 'For tomorrow' actions: effort advice when α1 band time > 60 s, fueling advice when decoupling ≥5 %, sleep/hydration check when 0 < HRR < 12.
Returns next-day advice by α1 band seconds: >300 s above AT2 recovery, >600 s between easy, >1200 s below AT1 'long aerobic', else light session.
File-scope: fills a rounded card tinted with colour at `tint` alpha and a solid 5 pt accent bar on its left edge.
File-scope: returns the HRR positive bullet for best 1-min drop ≥25 / ≥18 / ≥12 bpm, else nil.
